test_title: PYST 28: SSC CHSL - Reasoning (Held On: 17 March, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question:
By folding the given paper, which of the following box cannot be made?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2709fed20fc4b92ac264a0714e65779935e668e779dad70c6ccf517f7eee5e13.png]
solution:
Faces opposite to each other is shown below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/089a55522a588a5876d569ffc44edb593f5d6e181ed4e0454012dad5b5eaa340.png] 

1. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f6ce0aec36fd8e6dbf8dd4e82276e000bcbaf56e26e8d3c4a4d5324be6bf6eb.png] → Cannot be made (As, 1 and 4 are faces opposite to each other, so they cannot appear on the dice at the same time)

2. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0f7839aaf06b09588535c4fbcce5ae9dcc3cbc994a62805618379adfe0d53212.png] → Can be made

3. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bb6e1a08d7c8dabb1d289d0b0e6fce7a399753446ca253a1b493405bff5e7079.png] → Can be made

4. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4dfb8a5aac80cb4100c4f04824ccecf8f7815d6ab529292acb5f4fa4d30b0b06.png] → Can be made

Hence, '**option 1**' is the correct answer.
